literal: The seat of life is of the path of love; for those who lack that, the body is bone covered with skin.
translation: A living body is one that walks the path of love; for those who lack love, their body is merely bones clad in skin.
modern: அன்பின் வழியில் இயங்குவதே உயிருள்ள உடம்பாகும்; அன்பு இல்லாதவர்களுடைய உடம்பு வெறும் தோலால் மூடப்பட்ட எலும்பு மட்டுமே ஆகும்.
explanation: This couplet highlights the vital importance of love in defining true human existence. The author states that a body is truly alive only when it is guided by love. Without love, a person's physical form is nothing more than a lifeless skeleton wrapped in skin. The key contrast is between 'உயிர்நிலை' (the true seat of life) and a mere 'உடம்பு' (a physical body of bone and skin), showing that love is the animating force of human life.
